title: AquaCal real-rig calibration inputs (Record A): 13-camera ChArUco frameset
description:
Calibration inputs only. This record holds the raw ChArUco board observations consumed by the AquaCal 13-camera underwater production rig calibration. It contains no calibration result, no configuration file and no run output; those are published separately as Record B.

Contents (a single zip archive):

  • extrinsic/ — 13 per-camera directories of losslessly encoded PNG frames of a ChArUco board moved through the shared working volume (12 primary cameras plus 1 auxiliary fisheye).
  • intrinsic/ — 13 per-camera directories of per-camera intrinsic calibration frames.
  • README.md — the frameset's own description.

This record is immutable. It is re-versioned only if the capture itself changes. It exists so that the claim "these are the frames the run consumed" is verifiable against a fixed byte set: Zenodo publishes an MD5 for every file in the record.

Results computed from these frames — the calibration outputs, the configuration that produced them, and the run manifest recording the exact software environment — are published as the AquaCal real-rig results package, Record B: __RECORD_B_URL__ . Splitting inputs from results keeps this multi-gigabyte input record stable while the few megabytes of results are re-versioned independently.

Relationship to record 21889922. The earlier record 10.5281/zenodo.21889922 bundled these same inputs together with calibration outputs in one archive. That bundling is the defect this two-record split corrects. Record 21889922 remains available as the historical submitted package and is not withdrawn.

Software: AquaCal.
